text: Over 30 years, the chance of at least one major flood is about 26% on today's FEMA map, and about 35% once projected sea-level rise is included. By 2055, today's 100-year flood level floods about as often as a 53-year flood does today in the central projection. Raising the lowest floor 2 ft above the base flood elevation cuts the 30-year odds from 35% to 8%.
